recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-31422 unless a future WG decision revisits broader Reference datatype wording outside Bundle entry resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-31422 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested non-exclusive example wording for Bundle.entry.fullUrl, explicit clarification that fullUrl is not limited to urn:uuid, urn:oid, http, or https, and clarification that Reference.value/reference matching can use any URI scheme in addition to relative references.
initial_application: The explicit application is e084181ce7efd960c27096be172fcc0d0e845a81, titled "Updates to bundle-notes.xml and structuredefinition-Bundle.xml for FHIR-29271 and FHIR-31422." It added the e.g. short definition, arbitrary-URI fullUrl definition, and Bundle reference-resolution note for Reference.reference URI schemes; that commit is an ancestor of the current source.
additional_context: FHIR-29271 is the same-change-family issue that rewrote Bundle reference resolution. FHIR-I minutes on 2021-04-05 record the exact-matching rationale and Persuasive with Modification / 15-1-3 vote, and a follow-up Zulip thread confirms both Bundle.entry.fullUrl and reference.reference were intended. Later Bundle edits preserved this clarification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already says fullUrl can be an arbitrary URI and source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml already says reference.reference in entry resources can use any URI scheme.

related_jiras.note: Its Bundle reference-resolution rewrite was applied in the same source commit and provides the section where FHIR-31422 was inserted.
